install.unbabel-comet: 2.2.7 (pinned deps: numpy 1.26.4, transformers 4.46.3, huggingface-hub 0.26.5, pytorch-lightning 2.4.0, torchmetrics 0.10.3)

downloads: see verified.json: both checkpoints by SHA-256 (Hugging Face lfs.oid), plus the tokenizer.json (SHA-256), tokenizer_config.json and config.json (git blob SHA-1) of Davlan/afro-xlmr-large-76L, the encoder both checkpoints name; its 2.2 GB weights are not fetched (COMET rebuilds the encoder from its config and loads the weights from the checkpoint). score.py re-hashes the checkpoint before every load and runs with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.

limits.AfriCOMET: reference-based only (model card: 'receives a triplet'). It scores the sealed test sets, which carry native references; it cannot gate a live isiXhosa line, which has none.
limits.SSA-COMET: does reference-free QE, so it gates live isiZulu safety lines. On 21 dev lines a native corrected, it scores the rejected line (0.514) no lower than the correction (0.502): it catches wrong meaning, not the fine fixes a native makes.

threshold.why: Separates the 60 native dev lines from the same lines set against a wrong English: thresholds 0.28-0.33 tie at balanced accuracy 0.892 (0.33: 50/60 native lines pass, 57/60 wrong-English lines fail); the calibration policy takes the stricter on a tie. Used only in the safety rule, as Al's brief says.
